title: The Keeper's Hour trailer
voice: none: no narration; every word on screen is the game's own (night.txt, CC BY 4.0)

close.what: the end card, sweep 17: Tallow lifts his flame toward the credit line, then the trailer ends

length: 84 s: 21 lamp sweeps of 4 s (kh_world.c). Author, 2026-10-14, 'Keep the longer films.': the four card lines that had been trimmed at sentence boundaries (arrive, kettle_light, letters_read, decide) are whole again, each card holding long enough to read at 3 words a second.

segments.heading: LETTER
segments.speaker: LETTER
lines: By order of the Coastal Authority, the light at Relay Nine is to be extinguished at dawn. There is no longer a coast to guard.

segments.heading: TIDE
segments.speaker: TIDE
lines: There is a coast. You are standing on it. It just has no sea.

segments.heading: LENS
segments.speaker: LENS
lines: Three hundred and twelve facets of pressed glass. Each one holds a smaller lamp, turning.

segments.heading: KETTLE
segments.speaker: KETTLE
lines: Then nobody has done that since today. I will boil. It takes a while. Most things worth doing do.

segments.heading: STATIC
segments.speaker: STATIC
lines: ...this is the Marigold, out of nowhere... we have been at sea since the sea left... we navigate by you...

segments.heading: The game's dialogue box
segments.speaker: UI
segments.picture: the game's own dialogue box on the logbook's first line, as the game draws it (night.txt line 63, logbook)

segments.heading: TIDE
segments.speaker: TIDE
lines: "Dear Keeper, I can see your light from my bedroom. When it comes round I say goodnight to it. Does it say goodnight back. From Ilse, age 7."

segments.heading: LENS
segments.speaker: LENS
lines: When the beam crosses the town, the shape lifts a hand.

segments.heading: LEDGER
segments.speaker: LEDGER
lines: Dawn at 06:12. Fourteen minutes. The switch is on the wall, where it has always been, under a little brass cover.

segments.heading: TIDE
segments.speaker: TIDE
lines: Whatever you do, do it on purpose.

segments.heading: End card
card: About 25 minutes. Three endings. Free for Windows.
